occupation: Unorganized workers selling tea and snacks or food items
other_conditions: Must be registered with the Chhattisgarh Unorganized Workers State Social Security Board
Must have been registered with the board at least 90 days before application
Commercial vehicle drivers must possess a health certificate from the RTO
Applicants can receive benefits only once
Applicants who have already received benefits from any other parallel state scheme are ineligible
benefits_summary: A grant of ₹30,000 is provided, and the remaining amount is extended as a bank loan after submission of required loan documents.
